speech.heard: In Belarus, 65.7% of youth are neither working nor in school. In Japan, 3.1%. That gives Belarus the world's highest share of disengaged young people. Japan holds the world's lowest share, keeping nearly everyone learning or earning. India has 25.6% of young people aged 15 to 24 neither working nor in school. USA has 11.6 percent, while Germany drops to 8.2 percent. Norway has 6.2 percent, Sweden has 5 percent, and Netherlands has 3.9 percent. How does your country compare?
differences: base.en: '5.0%' heard as '5%' after '6.2% sweden has'
